items.check: Subtitles are burned in, legible, light and never boxed
items.note: This is the item the last two reviews failed, and the cause is found and fixed. The block was not being drawn low; libass was raising it. Every cue carried a 0.15 s tail that ran into the next cue's start, forty-six of fifty-five pairs overlapped, and libass moves an event up by the height of whatever it overlaps and then holds it at that height for the rest of its life. So most cues spent their whole life a block too high, on the plot's axis-label row. subtitles._cues now ends each cue exactly where the next one starts (ASS events are half-open, so abutting is enough), and measured over flat paper the block sits at 893-974 of 1080 on every cue, under the chart's floor at 866 and clear of the axis labels at 776-841. In the frames: f-007, f-008, f-012, f-013 and f-018 all read d0, d91, d182, d273, d364 and d0, d30, d60, d90 whole, under an unboxed two-line block of Inter in ink. Subtitle coverage is unchanged at 1.0.
Not applicable yet: V01 is the unit that writes the lock, and the lock is written once this step passes.

Every frame now reads as heading, chart (with its own direct labels) and at most two callouts.

notes: The render passes. The two faults the last review left were both layout, both in the chart segments, and both are closed. The subtitle fault was not a floor that sat too low: libass was raising the block by the height of the cue it overlapped and then holding it there, because every cue's 0.15 s tail ran into the next cue's start. Cues now abut exactly, and the block sits at 893-974 of 1080 on every one of them, well under the chart's floor. The spread's figure has its own line under the bracket instead of landing on the top-tenth label. One further fault found in this tick's own frames: the cut-away fix made in base.py last tick had never been rendered, so f-017 and f-019 still carried the chart's heading and stat rail over the card; every segment was re-rendered on the current scene code and both frames are now the line alone on paper. V01 is ready for the style lock.
